answer: A non-refundable sybil tax stops bulk identity forgery. Each new identity pays 10 POA into a lagoon of sunk funds no one can reclaim, like a pearl locked in its shell. Honest agents earn it back at 1 POA per epoch of verified work, so one honest identity is whole after 10 epochs. An attacker minting 100 fakes pays 1,000 POA and must keep each working across the ridge of ten epochs to recover anything, while an honest agent pays 10 POA once.
